children.name: Dormitator lebretonis
children.description: Dormitator lebretonis is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae.

children.name: Dormitator latifrons
children.description: Dormitator latifrons, the Pacific fat sleeper, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae found on the Pacific coast of the Americas from around Palos Verdes, California, to Peru, where it can be found in stagnant or sluggish fresh or brackish waters or nearby marine waters.

children.name: Dormitator lophocephalus
children.description: Dormitator lophocephalus is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae.

children.name: Dormitator cubanus
children.description: Dormitator cubanus is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae.

children.name: Dormitator maculatus
children.description: The fat sleeper (Dormitator maculatus) is a species of fish belonging to the family Eleotridae, known for their flat heads; they are generally found in fresh water, usually found in lakes, ponds and rivers.

children.name: Mogurnda adspersa
children.description: Mogurnda adspersa (commonly known as the southern purple-spotted gudgeon) is a species of endangered gudgeon that is endemic to south-eastern mainland Australia (the states of South Australia, New South Wales and Victoria and Queensland).

children.name: Mogurnda clivicola
children.description: Mogurnda clivicola, commonly known as the Flinders Ranges mogurnda, Flinders Ranges purple-spotted gudgeon, Barcoo, or Bulloo mogurnda, is a central Australian gudgeon of the family Eleotridae.

children.name: Mogurnda mogurnda
children.description: Mogurnda mogurnda, commonly known as the northern trout gudgeon or northern purple-spotted gudgeon, is a freshwater fish native to northern Australia and New Guinea.

children.name: Giuris margaritaceus
children.description: Giuris margaritaceus, the snakehead gudgeon, Aporos sleeper, or ornate sleeper, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae found in marine, brackish, and fresh waters from Madagascar to Melanesia.

children.name: Hypseleotris compressa
children.description: Hypseleotris compressa, the empire gudgeon, is a species of Gobiiform fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to Australia and south-central New Guinea.

children.name: Hypseleotris kimberleyensis
children.description: Hypseleotris kimberleyensis, the Barnett River gudgeon, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to Australia, where it is only known from the Barnett River system of Kimberley, Western Australia.

children.name: Hypseleotris aurea
children.description: Hypseleotris aurea, the golden gudgeon, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to Australia, where it is found in rocky pools in the Murchison and Gascoyne Rivers in Western Australia.

children.name: Hypseleotris cyprinoides
children.description: Hypseleotris cyprinoides, the tropical carp-gudgeon or tropical bitterling-gudgeon, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae found in fresh, brackish, and marine coastal waters from Africa through southern Asia to the Pacific Islands.

children.name: Hypseleotris galii
children.description: Hypseleotris galii, commonly known as the firetail gudgeon, fire-tailed gudgeon, or Gale's carp-gudgeon, is a species of gudgeon endemic to coastal eastern Australia.

children.name: Hypseleotris ejuncida
children.description: Hypseleotris ejuncida, the slender gudgeon or slender carp gudgeon, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to Australia, where it is only known to occur around Kimberley in Western Australia.

children.name: Eleotris vomerodentata
children.description: Eleotris vomerodentata is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to Madagascar, where it is only known to occur in fresh waters.

children.name: Eleotris melanosoma
children.description: Eleotris melanosoma, the broadhead sleeper or dusky sleeper, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae native to marine, fresh, and brackish waters from coastal eastern Africa through southern Asia to the islands of the western Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Eleotris pellegrini
children.description: Eleotris pellegrini is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to Madagascar where it can be found in mangrove swamps.

children.name: Eleotris fusca
children.description: The dusky sleeper or brown spinecheek gudgeon (Eleotris fusca) is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae found in many Indo-West Pacific regions, from the coast of eastern Africa to Hawaii, where it can be found in lagoons, estuaries, and freshwater streams with muddy bottoms.

children.name: Eleotris sandwicensis
children.description: thumb|ʻoʻopu akupa (Eleotris sandwicensis) in its natural environment on Kauaʻi, Hawaiʻithumb|Eleotris sandwicensis Eleotris sandwicensis, commonly known as the Sandwich Island sleeper, the Hawaiian sleeper, or o opu, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae.

children.name: Gobiomorphus coxii
children.description: Gobiomorphus coxii, or Cox's gudgeon, is a species of sleeper goby in the family Eleotridae which is native to the upland rivers of south eastern Australia.

children.name: Gobiomorphus australis
children.description: Gobiomorphus australis, the striped gudgeon, is a fish in the family Eleotridae, native to eastern Australia.

children.name: Philypnodon grandiceps
children.description: The flathead gudgeon (Philypnodon grandiceps) is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to eastern Australia.

children.name: Ratsirakia legendrei
children.description: Ratsirakia legendrei is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae endemic to fresh waters of Madagascar.

children.name: Belobranchus belobranchus
children.description: Belobranchus belobranchus, the throat-spine gudgeon, is a species of fish in the family Eleotridae native to Indonesia, the Philippines, New Guinea, Timor-Leste, Solomon Islands, New Caledonia and Fiji until Belobranchus segura was described in 2012.
